name: VR Delivery Tycoon
summary:
This game lets you be someone you always dreamed to be - package delivery station operator!!

We all had this dream when we were kids, now thanks to advancements in technology and science - you can realize this dream!! Wait no more, strap yourself in and throw some packages at random buildings in a rage fuelled fit! Erm, I mean, deliver some packages.

Slightly sandboxy game about packages. Can packages be fun? Maybe. In VR? Definitely.

Throw them, deliver them, try to hit a drone with them? Have fun :)
